description: Report the plan, monthly and daily call usage, remaining quota, reset times, rate limit and overage status for the DoorProfit API key authenticating this session. Takes no arguments — it always describes the calling key, never another account. Call it when the user asks how many calls they have left, or after any other tool returns QUOTA_EXCEEDED or DAILY_LIMIT_EXCEEDED, to confirm the limit and reset time before suggesting an upgrade. This is the only tool that never consumes quota.
name: get_api_usage

daily.description: Daily limit, used, remaining, and reset time.

monthly.description: Monthly limit, used, remaining, and reset time.

plan.description: Plan type, name, and monthly price.

title: Check API Usage & Quota
